snippet.title: Smashteroids | Gameplay Promo Trailer
snippet.description:
SMASHTEROIDS is an arcade space shooter with roguelite runs. You clear stages of asteroids and enemies, buy items in a shop between stages, and by the late game the item stacking has mostly replaced the screen with particles. Everything here is real gameplay from the current build — the split at the end is three of the campaign bosses (The Antipode, Syzygy, The Crucible).

Currently: 22 playable ships, 19 bosses, around 175 items. Made in Godot by one person.

Wishlist on Steam: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4879750/Smashteroids/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=description&utm_campaign=promo-video

A free demo is planned for late September, and the game will be in Steam Next Fest this October.

Discord: https://discord.gg/DDUzNgRYkX
Website: https://smashteroids.com
